questions.question: Which method was used to handle missing values in the Age attribute?

explanations.a: Missing values in the Age attribute were replaced using the mean, which represents the average age in the dataset.
explanations.b: The median method was not used for handling missing values in the Age attribute.
explanations.c: The mode is generally used for categorical data and was not applied to the Age attribute.
explanations.d: Records with missing Age values were retained to avoid unnecessary data loss.

questions.question: Why was the mean preferred for filling missing values in the Age column?

answers.a: It represents the average value of the data
answers.d: It converts data into numeric form

explanations.a: The mean provides the average age of individuals and ensures uniform replacement of missing values.
explanations.b: The mean does not remove duplicate values; it only replaces missing entries.
explanations.c: Using the mean does not affect the number of records in the dataset.
explanations.d: The mean is a statistical measure and does not perform data type conversion.

questions.question: How were missing values in the Embarked attribute handled?

explanations.a: Missing values were replaced with the category that appears most frequently in the Embarked attribute.
explanations.b: The mean cannot be applied to categorical attributes like Embarked.
explanations.c: The median is suitable for numerical data and not for categorical variables.
explanations.d: Rows with missing values were not removed to avoid unnecessary data loss.

questions.question: Which attribute was encoded to convert categorical data into numerical form?

explanations.a: Age is a numerical attribute and does not require encoding.
explanations.b: Fare is already a numerical attribute and does not require encoding.
explanations.c: Sex is a categorical attribute and was encoded to convert it into numerical form for machine learning models.
explanations.d: Pclass is represented using numerical values and was not encoded in this process.

questions.question: Which of the following best describes the role of encoding in machine learning models?

answers.b: It converts categorical attributes into a machine-readable format

explanations.a: Encoding alone does not guarantee accuracy improvement.
explanations.b: Encoding converts categorical variables into numerical representations required by machine learning algorithms.
explanations.c: Feature removal is part of feature selection, not encoding.
explanations.d: Scaling is performed using normalization or standardization, not encoding.

questions.question: Which features were normalized in the experiment?

explanations.a: Sex and Embarked are categorical features and are handled using encoding, not normalization.
explanations.b: Age and Fare are numerical features and were normalized to bring them to a common scale.
explanations.c: Sex is categorical and not suitable for normalization.
explanations.d: Embarked is categorical and Pclass was not normalized in this experiment.

questions.question: What problem does normalization help prevent in machine learning models?

answers.b: Bias due to large numerical feature values

explanations.a: Missing values are handled using imputation methods.
explanations.b: Normalization prevents features with larger ranges from dominating the learning process.
explanations.c: Class labels are not affected by normalization.
explanations.d: Overfitting is mainly handled using regularization and validation techniques.

questions.question: When was data visualization performed in the experiment?

explanations.a: Data visualization cannot be performed before the dataset is loaded.
explanations.b: Visualization was performed after preprocessing, not before handling missing values.
explanations.c: Visualization was carried out after cleaning and preprocessing to better understand the refined data.
explanations.d: Dataset collection is a separate step and does not involve data visualization.

questions.question: What is the main advantage of performing data visualization after preprocessing?

answers.a: To convert categorical features into numbers
answers.b: To validate the effectiveness of preprocessing steps

explanations.a: Encoding handles categorical conversion, not visualization.
explanations.b: Visualization helps confirm correct handling of missing values, scaling, and feature distributions.
explanations.c: Model training is not done using visualization.
explanations.d: Visualization does not change dataset size.

questions.question: The final output of this experiment is:

explanations.a: Model training was not part of this experiment.
explanations.b: The dataset was processed and cleaned, not left in raw form.
explanations.c: The experiment focused on preprocessing and feature engineering, resulting in a clean dataset.
explanations.d: Feature reduction was not performed in this experiment.
